description: This file is a test script written in shell, designed to verify the behavior of disabling local paths in git clone/fetch operations, including setup of repositories, testing rejection of invalid paths, and ensuring correct fetch behavior.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specific message in the test repository.

methods.name: test_proto
